note: The sentences `daoris driver landing`, `helpers` and `commits` say as a rule is set, which Ask Daoris's cards say too (TWINWORDS1, D164's DOORS1a note). The CLI's driverconfig.ts and the driver's HelpSettingProposals each say them from their own code; each suite reads this table, so a change to one side's words fails the other's test.

ticket.says: `{ticket}` is the first match of `[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-\d+` in the title, then the request, then its links, as written (the default shape); where none is found, the session's id stands in.
`{ticket}` is the first match of `TK-\d+` in the title, then the request, then its links, as written; where none is found, the session's id stands in.

squash: Squashed: Accept makes the pull request's branch one commit from the session's work — the quest's title, then each of the session's commits' subjects — made by git as the repository's own `user.name` and `user.email`; where git has none there, Accept is refused and says how to set them. A tree on a branch of its own lands as it stands.

helpers.says: Each helper an agent asks for waits for your yes.
A helper an agent asks for starts at once, within the limits: two at once for a session, one turn each.
A helper is not offered to a session here: only your own press asks one.

commits.says: Each piece that passes its checks is committed as the work goes.
Each commit waits for your yes before it is made.
One commit is made when the work is done.
